name: Extinguish the Firegut
label: Quest
description: Extinguish the Firegut: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We must strike at our enemies before they strike at us!

The Firegut ogres of the Burning Steppes are allies of the Blackrock orcs. They work closely with those vile orcs, keeping the mineral rich Dreadmaul Rock guarded and the supply lines open at all times.
Leave your mark, friend. Cripple their forces and return to me when the job is done.

clips.title: Progress
paras: There is not nearly enough blood on your uniform, soldier!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Outstanding, soldier! The orcs and ogres will be reeling from this blow for minutes, maybe even hours!
